newsitem.title: JAPAN: OLYMPICS-NAGANO GAMES TICKETS SELL OUT WITHIN MINUTES.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-NAGANO GAMES TICKETS SELL OUT WITHIN MINUTES.

text.p: Tickets for some events at next year's Nagano Winter Olympics sold out within minutes of going on sale in Japan on Monday, officials said.
Hundreds of people queued all night in Nagano in the hope of securing seats for the opening ceremony, figure skating and ice hockey.
But many were turned away disappointed after the tickets were snapped up within minutes, agents said.

The 244,000 tickets that went on sale on Monday represented some 40 percent of the tickets allotted for advance sale in Japan, an official from the Nagano Olympic Winter Games Organising Committee (NAOC) said.
Others tickets have been reserved for package tours or for sale at the door.

The organising committee said the brisk sales in Japan, which has been allotted about 80 percent of the total of 1.2 million tickets for the Games, would not affect overseas sales which are handled through agents designated by National Olympic Committees.
